For those who have succeeded where many have failed and who have come this far, the only thing that stands between them and [[Ascension]] is the [[Doppelganger]]. It is their mirror image which they must defeat alone to test their ability to outsmart their foes. Against it there is no relying on expensive equipment or hiding behind party members.

The Doppelganger copies your character's set of skills, and uses its own set of attributes, health, and energy. The player must devise a way to defeat the Doppelganger by exploiting its weaknesses; for the most part, these lie in its very basic [[AI]], which does not include complex strategies (such as [[skill chain]]ing).

==Missions==
*[[Crystal Desert]]
**[[Augury Rock]]

==Skills==
*The Doppelganger always has 12 in all [[attribute]]s in both your primary and secondary professions, excluding the [[primary attribute]] of your secondary profession.
*It has the same [[skill bar]] as its opponent.
*It cannot use any [[List of PvE-only skills|PvE-only skills]] (with the ''exception'' of the [[List of Anniversary Celebration elite skills|10 Anniversary elite skills]]); however, they still take a slot on its skill bar.

== Notes ==
{{see|Augury Rock/Guide}} ''for strategies against the Doppelganger''
* Only the player's skill bar is copied. The player's armor or equipment does not affect the Doppelganger.
* The Doppelganger always has 480 [[health]] in [[Normal mode]] and 880 health in [[Hard mode]].
* The Doppelganger never has a pet, even when [[Charm Animal]], [[Comfort Animal]], or [[Heal as One]] is equipped.
* The Doppelganger switches between a [[Chaos Axe]] (which deals [[lightning damage]]) and a [[Tormented Spear]], depending on the distance from its [[target]]. With the axe equipped it can use [[melee attack|melee attack skills]] of every type, and with the spear equipped it can use [[ranged attack|ranged attack skills]] of every type.
** When it uses attack skills linked to a weapon type, the Doppelganger appears to use the [[attack speed]] of the appropriate weapon.
* At the beginning of the encounter, the Doppelganger is [[enchantment|enchanted]] with [[Divine Fire]].
* The Doppelganger is not [[human]], since [[disease]] does not spread to or from it.
* The Doppelganger's appearance is based on the character's sex.

==Trivia==
*The Doppelganger is technically a [[monk]] (i.e. it [[drop]]s monk [[skill tome]]s in Hard mode), but effectively mimics any profession via attributes. Presumably, in the game's mechanics, profession cannot be changed in an [[instance]].
*Doppelganger was called "Mirror Self" before the [[Game updates/20050615|June 15, 2005 update]].
*For long-range attacks, the Doppelganger formerly wielded an [[Eternal Bow]], but began using a Tormented Spear at some point after the release of ''[[Guild Wars Nightfall]]''.
*Before the [[Feedback:Game updates/20100118|January 18, 2010 update]], the Doppelganger was able to copy and use [[Vampirism]] at [[Sunspear rank]] 9, even though it is a PvE-only skill.
*The word doppelganger is derived from the German [[w:Doppelgänger|Doppelgänger]], which literally translates to 'double-walker' or 'double-goer.' In folklore, it refers to the spectral double of a living person and is traditionally considered a bad omen or evil spirit.
